info.name: LOVO AI Genny API
info.description: REST API for LOVO AI's Genny text-to-speech and voice generation platform. Base URL https://api.genny.lovo.ai. Authenticated with the X-API-KEY header. API access requires an active subscription; rate limit 20 requests/min; text capped at 500 characters per conversion; audio URLs valid 24 hours.

items.docs: Submit an asynchronous text-to-speech job. Returns a job with an id to poll via GET /tts/{jobId}. Optional callbackUrls (max 4) receive a POST webhook on completion.
Convert text to speech synchronously. 90-second timeout; returns a pending async job if synthesis exceeds the timeout.

params.name: jobId
params.description: The job id returned by a TTS request.

items.docs: Retrieve a TTS job by id. Returns generated audio URLs (valid 24 hours) once completed.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by displayName, locale, gender, speakerType, or ageRange. No whitespace.

items.docs: Retrieve all speakers with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination. Each speaker includes id, locale, gender, avatar, age range, and available styles with sample audio URLs.
Get team billing and usage information for the account associated with the API key - team name, subscription status/interval, current period, and metered usage.
